_doc: User-facing strings for Usage Dashboard. PR-Dash-1 seeds title + screen labels + time-range labels. PR-Dash-2 adds Overview KPI labels, funnel stage labels, outcome event labels, and empty-state copy. PR-Dash-3 adds providerModel + outcomeValue screen copy and the 'What was this about' detail-panel per-feature labels. PR-Dash-4 adds inlineReceipt + contextRing + curatorPush strings for the three new carriers (A/B/C).
